# OpenThesis 0.3.0

## 中文

本版本让个人投资者更容易使用自己的模型，并改善小窗口和 Windows 高 DPI 下
的操作体验。

- 新增 DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi、GLM、OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter、Ollama
  八类常用入口，同时保留自定义 OpenAI-compatible 接口。
- 每个入口内置推荐模型；用户点击“刷新在线模型”时，应用才会后台访问模型目录。
- 在线目录不可用、认证失败或返回异常时，内置列表与手动输入仍然可用。
- API Key 仅保存在本次会话内，主模型与第二对比模型各自独立。
- 修复 `980×680`、高缩放场景下左下角内容被截断的问题。
- 反向 DCF 与第二对比模型默认折叠，研究控制区和模型设置页支持纵向滚动。
- 改进 OpenAI-compatible 兼容性：可按预设省略 `temperature`，并只在明确不支持
  `response_format` 时进行一次安全降级重试。

下载 `OpenThesis-0.3.0-windows-x64-portable.zip`，完整解压后运行
`OpenThesis.exe`。请保持 `_internal` 文件夹与 EXE 位于同一目录。

首次启动默认“不调用 AI”。只有用户主动选择模型并开始研究时，研究上下文才会
发送给所选接口。OpenThesis 不连接券商，也不执行交易。

## English

This release makes bring-your-own-model research easier and fixes usability at
the `980×680` minimum window size and on high-DPI Windows displays.

- Adds presets for DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, and
  Ollama, while preserving arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- Keeps built-in recommended models available and refreshes remote catalogs only
  after an explicit user click.
- Preserves manual entry and built-in fallbacks when discovery fails.
- Keeps API keys in memory for the current session; primary and comparison
  models have separate credentials and settings.
- Adds scrollable research/model settings and collapsed reverse-DCF/comparison
  sections.
- Improves request compatibility through optional `temperature` and one narrowly
  scoped retry without unsupported `response_format`.

Download `OpenThesis-0.3.0-windows-x64-portable.zip`, extract it completely, and
run `OpenThesis.exe` with the adjacent `_internal` directory intact.

The first launch defaults to no AI calls. Research context is sent only after the
user selects a model and starts research. OpenThesis never connects to a broker
or executes trades.
